identity.name: Franklin Responsibly Sourced Gold ETF (Ondo Tokenized ETF)

about.description: FGDLon is an Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure designed to provide economic exposure to Franklin Responsibly Sourced Gold ETF, which seeks to reflect the price of gold bullion, less fund expenses. The ETF uses gold sourced from LBMA-accredited refiners that are required to demonstrate compliance with the LBMA Responsible Gold Guidance. The token is designed to be fully backed by the underlying publicly traded ETF, together with cash in transit, held with regulated custodial broker-dealers. Tokenholders are not shareholders of the underlying.
about.registryInfo: Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited issues Ondo Global Markets tokens as structured notes designed to track the performance of the corresponding underlying publicly traded stock or ETF (including dividends, which are reinvested where applicable). The notes are governed by the Issuer’s Sales Terms under Swiss law. GM tokens are fully backed 1:1 by the corresponding underlying securities held with regulated custodial broker-dealers, plus an additional collateral buffer. Ondo publishes ongoing attestations and reporting for GM token backing (verified by Ankura Trust Company).
